meta.title: Tarrant County Voter Guide
meta.note: Race names, candidate names, and party labels are transcribed from the Texas Secretary of State Ballot Certification Report for the November 3, 2026 general election in Tarrant County (sources/ballot-certification-2026-11-03.pdf). Endorsement and donation data has not been collected yet; those arrays are empty for every candidate. Each entry carries a ballotOrder keyed by county name: its 1-based position in that county's certification report, which is the order the races and the candidates within each race appear on that county's printed ballot.
